name: Chiropractic & Physical Therapy
title: Field Sales Team for Chiropractors and PTs | Our Wellness Network
description: Field sales for chiropractors and physical therapists in Naperville, Downers Grove and Lombard. We visit nearby gyms and studios and build a referral network you can track.
cardBlurb: We visit the gyms, studios and running stores near your practice and build a network you can track.
intro: Our software finds the businesses near your practice where active people spend their time. Every month our field team visits them, meets their staff and leaves your printed materials, with permission.
partnersIntro: Active people already spend their time at these places, and the staff there know them well.

partners.name: Gyms and fitness studios
partners.why: Their members train often and care about how their body moves.

partners.name: Yoga and pilates studios
partners.why: Regulars pay close attention to posture, balance and how they feel.

partners.name: Running stores
partners.why: Runners come in for new shoes and talk about their training with the staff.

partners.name: Bike shops
partners.why: Riders who spend long hours on the bike stop in for tune-ups and gear.

partners.name: Martial arts and dance studios
partners.why: Students of every age stay active, and their families know the staff well.

partners.name: Golf shops and indoor golf
partners.why: Golfers come in all year to practice, play and shop for gear.

treatsIntro: On every visit, our field team brings coffee and treats for the whole staff at each partner business, from the front desk to every coach and instructor. It's simple hospitality, it's the reason staff are glad to see us, and it's included in your plan.
treatExamples: Coffee and pastries for a gym's early morning crew
Cold drinks and snacks for a running store's weekend staff
Coffee and cookies for a bike shop's mechanics
portalNote: Every sign-up lands in your portal with the business and staff member whose code it came through, so your front desk can call and book, and the call comes from your practice, not from us. Together the sign-ups show which businesses, visits and routes are working.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: Every partner business signs a one-page agreement: mutual promotion, and nobody is paid per referral or per patient.

notes.title: No patient records, ever
notes.text: We never receive patient records, and partners never see who signed up. The sign-up form asks no health questions, and your front desk makes the calls.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We make no medical or health claims and never describe your services in words you haven't approved.

exclusivity: Partners agree to promote one practice like yours, and only yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Which businesses would you visit for my practice?
faq.a: Non-competing businesses near you where active people spend their time, like gyms, yoga and pilates studios, running stores and bike shops. Our business matching software ranks them for your practice, and you approve the list before any visit.

faq.q: What about the rules for healthcare practices?
faq.a: Partner programs for healthcare practices are reviewed for compliance with applicable state rules before launch. We never receive patient records, partners never see who signed up, and the sign-up form asks no health questions. If you'd like your own counsel to review the partner agreement, we'll send it to them.

faq.q: Can we keep the relationships we already have?
faq.a: Yes. We skip businesses you already work with unless you ask us to visit them too, and those relationships stay yours.
